svg.title: Caribbean Current: OSW editorial reference-route candidate
svg.desc: Equirectangular schematic. Approximately 2800 km. Selected westward Caribbean regional route from a Windward Islands approach to the Belize/Yucatan transition near 19 N. Excludes the northward Yucatan Current, Loop and Florida currents, additional island entry branches, Colombia-Panama gyre circuits and eddy perimeters. No unique continuous axis or whole-system length asserted. Source describes regional geography; OSW selects the drawn route. No measured current axis.
svg.text: OSW approximate Caribbean regional corridor — candidate
Dashed: nominal route · pale: 54 editorial scenarios
Not an observed axis or statistical confidence interval
Source: Centurioni & Niiler (2003); OSW selects vertices
Equirectangular OSW atlas ground · scientific review pending
